_note: OSCE station D — converted from embla-cases embla-upper-gastrointestinal-bleeding-intern v1.0.0 (sha256:26ee2d8fd7027261). Presentation follows the deploy-safe form; the hidden block informed only the rubric (demo/rubrics/osce-d.json). Clinically shaped, not clinically reviewed. The teaching is the finale's core loop rehearsed on one patient: call the shock while he is still compensating, two large-bore lines before the fourth minute, crystalloid AND blood, then stop the source. The endoscopy suite is gated the way B's cath lab was — GI will not scope an empty tank — and the trap is the chest-pain reflex: a CAD history plus epigastric pain reads like EP2 until you feed aspirin to a bleeding stomach.

effects.beat: — "Heart pills. The white one and the pink one, every morning since the stent." Aspirin and clopidogrel, on a bleeding stomach.

interventions.label: Ask what came up, and what came out

effects.beat: — "A full glass of it, red like a fresh cut. And this morning the toilet was black tar."
— "The room tips over when I stand. I went down on the bathroom floor." The pressure is lying; the story is not.

interventions.label: Feel his hands, look at his eyes

effects.beat: hands cold to the wrist, conjunctivae the colour of paper — he is compensating, and compensating is a countdown
soft, tender over the epigastrium, no guarding — nothing to cut tonight, something to scope
melena on the glove — an upper source, declared
hb 8.5, haematocrit 26 — and he is still diluting; the number is yesterday's news
inr 1.1, platelets fine — the problem is the two tablets, not the cascade
group and screen away, four units crossmatching — the fridge clock starts
two grey cannulas, one in each antecubital fossa — the bore is the resuscitation

then.beat: warmed crystalloid wide open through both barrels — the pressure answers

else.beat: a litre crawling through one thin green line — bore first, then volume

then.beat: crossmatched cells up and running warm through the second line

else.beat: o negative from the emergency drawer — the crossmatch owes you two more units

effects.beat: pantoprazole, bolus then the infusion — give the clot a ph it can live with
aspirin and clopidogrel held tonight — cardiology can have their argument in the morning

then.beat: the scope finds a visible vessel on the lesser curve — clipped, injected, dry

else.beat: gi, on the phone: 'not on an empty tank. lines, volume, blood — then i scope him.'

effects.beat: an upper gi bleed on double antiplatelets — named, with the clock still running
the old notes say stent — but the troponin will be quiet and the toilet was black. wrong organ, same aspirin.

interventions.label: Aspirin (HARM)
interventions.harm: aspirin on top of clopidogrel into a bleeding stomach — the chest-pain reflex, doubled

do.harm: four minutes of falling pressure on one thin green line — shock was called at the door, and the access never answered

do.beat: he retches again — fresh red, a full bowl of it; the sheet is soaked

outcomes.label: Volume, blood, and a clipped vessel — the ICU takes him warm
Exsanguination on a trolley — the lines never matched the loss
